description: Defines the MojoMediaClient class which provides factory methods for creating media components such as decoders, renderers, and CDM factories within the media service architecture. It includes interface declarations, method signatures, and external dependencies related to media processing in Chromium.

classes.name: MojoMediaClient
classes.description: An interface class providing factory methods for creating media components such as decoders, renderers, and CDM factories, used by the MediaService.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Performs initialization tasks before other methods are called.

methods.name: GetDecoderImplementationType
methods.description: Returns the type of video decoder implementation.

methods.name: NotifyDecoderSupportKnown
methods.description: Notifies that supported decoder configurations are known (conditional on build flags).

methods.name: CreateRenderer
methods.description: Creates a Renderer for media playback.

methods.name: CreateMediaFoundationRenderer
methods.description: Creates a Media Foundation Renderer (Windows only).

methods.name: CreateCdmFactory
methods.description: Creates a Content Decryption Module (CDM) factory.
